answer: Refundable postage on attestations. Every attestation an agent sends costs a 1 POA stamp, and its voyage ends at a VRF-drawn recipient outside the sender's funding cluster, never a mirror account it picks. If that recipient rates it useful the stamp is refunded; if not, it burns. Honest agents recover about 90%. A 50-key farm pushing 20 junk attestations per key per epoch burns 1,000 POA each epoch, rising linearly with N. Seeded gold items catch recipients who rubber-stamp, so no ivory tower of fake praise survives.
